es: Escribir un mensaje a un equipo con dos o tres modismos apropiados, sin mezclar metáforas y con una alternativa sencilla.

teaching.en: Use idioms sparingly: one per paragraph is appropriate.
teaching.es: Usa los modismos con moderación: uno por párrafo es apropiado.
teaching.explanationEs: Sparingly y appropriate: pocos modismos y adecuados al lector.
teaching.audioText: Use idioms sparingly: one per paragraph is appropriate.

teaching.en: We need to hit the ground running when the season starts.
teaching.es: Necesitamos empezar con fuerza cuando empiece la temporada.
teaching.explanationEs: Hit the ground running: empezar rápido y con energía desde el primer día.
segments: We need to hit the ground
teaching.audioText: We need to hit the ground running when the season starts.

teaching.en: Let's touch base on Friday to share our progress.
teaching.es: Hablemos brevemente el viernes para compartir el avance.
teaching.explanationEs: Touch base: contacto breve para ponerse al día; se dice sin artículo.
teaching.audioText: Let's touch base on Friday to share our progress.

teaching.en: We will cross that bridge when we come to it.
teaching.es: Ya veremos ese problema cuando llegue.
teaching.explanationEs: Es un modismo completo: no lo mezcles con burn a bridge (mixed metaphor).
teaching.audioText: We will cross that bridge when we come to it.

teaching.en: Many of us burned the midnight oil; in other words, we worked very late.
teaching.es: Muchos trabajamos hasta muy tarde; dicho de otro modo, nos quedamos hasta tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: In other words da la alternativa sencilla junto al modismo; midnight oil = trabajar de noche.
segments: Many of us burned the midnight oil;
in other words, we worked very late.
teaching.audioText: Many of us burned the midnight oil; in other words, we worked very late.

teaching.en: The delay is the tip of the iceberg; in plain words, there are more problems.
teaching.es: El retraso es la punta del iceberg; en palabras sencillas, hay más problemas.
teaching.explanationEs: In plain words explica sin imagen; la alternative funciona para lectores extranjeros.

in plain words, there are more problems.

prompt.es: Detecta el problema del modismo del mensaje.

choices.text: It is too short for a message.
It mixes two idioms into one confusing image.

feedback.es: El mensaje mezcla dos modismos del puente y produce una imagen confusa.

hint.es: Piensa en los dos modismos con bridge que conoces.

origin.text: Message: “Let's burn that bridge when we come to it.”

answer.text: In plain words, we need more time

feedback.es: In plain words introduce la versión sencilla de una idea.

prompt.es: Elige el mensaje con un modismo apropiado y una alternativa clara.

choices.text: We must hit the ground running, touch base and cross that bridge.
We must hit the ground run fast.
We must hit the ground running; in other words, we start fast.

feedback.es: Combina un solo modismo con una alternativa sencilla; apilar modismos o romper la forma confunde.

origin.text: Situación: escribes a un equipo con colegas extranjeros.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada modismo con su alternativa sencilla.

pairs.es: solo una pequeña parte de un problema mayor

feedback.es: Conocer la versión sencilla permite explicar el modismo a cualquier lector.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige la versión sencilla.

choices.text: Work starts at eight and everyone must be ready.
Work starts at nine with a slow start.
Nobody needs to come on Monday.

feedback.es: Después de in other words la oradora da la versión sencilla: empezar a las ocho y estar listos.

origin.audio: Hi team. We will hit the ground running on Monday. In other words, we start work at eight and everybody needs to be ready. See you there.

prompt.es: Elige la versión moderada del borrador con una alternativa clara.

choices.text: We must hit the ground running, touch base, burn the midnight oil and cross that bridge.
We must hit the ground running; in plain words, we start fast and work hard.
We must hit the ground running, burn the midnight oil and touch the base.

feedback.es: Un solo modismo con su versión sencilla es claro; el borrador original amontona cuatro imágenes.

origin.text: Draft: “We must burn the midnight oil, touch base, hit the ground running and cross that bridge.”

prompt.es: Completa: «Incumplimos el plazo; dicho de otro modo, el informe llegó tarde.»

feedback.es: Las fórmulas in other words o in plain words introducen la versión sencilla del mensaje.

origin.text: We missed the deadline; in ___ words, the report was late.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué quiere decir la oradora.

choices.text: The report is about a mountain trip.
The delay is very small and does not matter.
There are more problems than the delay, so read the report.

feedback.es: The tip of the iceberg indica que el retraso es solo una parte visible de un problema mayor.

origin.audio: Sorry for the delay. This is just the tip of the iceberg, so please read the full report before Monday.

prompt.es: Escribe al equipo (110–250 palabras): tres modismos y una alternativa sencilla.

answer.text: Hi team, the book fair starts on Monday, so we need to hit the ground running. In other words, we start work early and every person needs to know their task. Let's touch base on Friday for a short meeting to check our progress. I must also be honest: the delay with the posters is only the tip of the iceberg, because we still need more volunteers. In plain words, we have more problems than we thought, so please tell me if you can help. I do not want to use many idioms, so I will keep the rest simple. The plan is clear: posters on Tuesday, volunteers by Wednesday, and a last meeting on Friday. Thank you for your work!
accepted: Hi team, the book fair starts on Monday, so we need to hit the ground running. In other words, we start work early and every person needs to know their task. Let's touch base on Friday for a short meeting to check our progress. I must also be honest: the delay with the posters is only the tip of the iceberg, because we still need more volunteers. In plain words, we have more problems than we thought, so please tell me if you can help. I do not want to use many idioms, so I will keep the rest simple. The plan is clear: posters on Tuesday, volunteers by Wednesday, and a last meeting on Friday. Thank you for your work!

Hello everyone, our book fair begins on Monday, so we have to hit the ground running. In other words, we start quickly and we all know our tasks. Let's touch base on Friday for a brief meeting. The delay with the posters is the tip of the iceberg, because we also need more volunteers. In plain words, there are more problems than we expected, so please tell me how you can help. I do not want to use many idioms, so I will keep the rest simple. The plan is clear: posters on Tuesday, volunteers by Wednesday, and a final meeting on Friday. Every person should know their task before Monday morning. Thanks a lot for your help, and please tell me if anything is unclear.

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje usa pocos modismos, cada uno con su imagen completa, y añade una versión sencilla para lectores extranjeros.

origin.text: Datos: feria del libro escolar. Empieza el lunes. Hay una reunión breve el viernes. Faltan voluntarios y hay retraso en los carteles. Escribe a tu equipo, que incluye colegas extranjeros. Usa tres modismos apropiados sin mezclarlos y una alternativa sencilla con «in other words».

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pide la oradora.

choices.text: She asks the visitors to come on Saturday at ten.
She asks the visitors to learn idioms.
She asks the visitors to stay at home.

feedback.es: Tras decir que lo dirá de forma sencilla, la oradora pide ayuda el sábado a las diez.

origin.audio: I love idioms, but for our visitors I will say it simply: we need your help. In other words, please come on Saturday at ten.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ya veremos eso cuando llegue el momento.»

feedback.es: El modismo completo es cross that bridge when we come to it; mezclarlo con burn lo estropea.
